description: LLM model configuration with profile support and hardware-informed device profiles (ADR-0033)

fast.description: Fast Ollama embedding (aligns with pgvector vector(768))

quality.description: Same width as fast; swap model when using another 768-dim Ollama embedder

llama3.1:8b.description: Llama 3.1 8B - LLMfit Windows fast profile (score 79.4, 92.1 tok/s). Native context is 128K but synthesis_budget is kept conservative for fast-profile latency; raise if larger clusters need more room (ADR-0033)

qwen3:14b.description: Qwen 3 14B - LLMfit balanced profile for both Windows and macOS (score 72.2, ~50 tok/s on Windows). Newer generation than qwen2.5:14b (ADR-0033)

deepseek-r1:14b.description: DeepSeek R1 14B - LLMfit Windows quality profile (highest score, 84.9, 51.2 tok/s). Reasoning model - emits <think> blocks by default; output_reserved increased to absorb chain-of-thought tokens. JSON-output compliance not yet validated against llm_output.py - see #332 before enabling as default (ADR-0033)

mlx-community--Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-4bi.description: Llama 3.2 3B (MLX 4-bit) - macOS fast profile, served via oMLX (device_profiles.darwin.backend = 'mlx'). Native context 131K per /v1/models, capped to oMLX's configured max_context_window (32768). Validated against llm_output.py on real synthesis/entity prompts: PARSE_OK via brace-matching repair (trailing chat-template noise after JSON closes on raw /v1/completions, not a parsing failure) (#336)

lmstudio-community--Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instru.description: Qwen 3 30B-A3B MoE (MLX 4-bit) - macOS balanced profile, served via oMLX (device_profiles.darwin.backend = 'mlx'). ~3B active params per token keeps latency low despite the 30B total size. Native context 262K per /v1/models, capped to oMLX's configured max_context_window (32768). Validated against llm_output.py: PARSE_OK, no repairs, faster than the qwen2.5:14b Ollama baseline on both synthesis and entity-extraction prompts (#336)

unsloth--Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-MLX-4bit.description: Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B MoE (MLX 4-bit, unsloth dynamic quant) - macOS quality profile, served via oMLX (device_profiles.darwin.backend = 'mlx'). Native context 262K per /v1/models, capped to oMLX's configured max_context_window (32768). Occasionally emits an empty <think></think> wrapper (unlike deepseek-r1:14b's verbose chain-of-thought flagged in #332) plus trailing chat-template noise after the JSON closes on raw /v1/completions - both handled by llm_output.py's brace-matching repair (validated PARSE_OK on real synthesis/entity prompts, #336). The unquantized bfloat16 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B build was rejected separately during fitness testing (507 insufficient-storage on load, unrelated silent JSON failures)

device_profiles._description: Platform key -> profile name -> model tag (ADR-0033). Consulted by SettingsService.get_active_model()/get_backend_type() before the generic 'profiles' fallback below (wired in via #319/#335). Windows values pending live validation (#332, incl. deepseek-r1:14b JSON-output risk). Darwin runs the 'mlx' backend (#335/#336) served by a shared oMLX instance (OMLX_BASE_URL/OMLX_API_KEY env vars) instead of Ollama; model IDs are oMLX/HuggingFace-style, not Ollama tags. An optional 'backend' key per platform (default 'ollama') selects the inference backend; stories.py/entities.py/topics.py and the health/status routers all resolve it via LLMService.backend (#337) rather than talking to ollama.Client directly.

fast.name: Fast
fast.description: Optimized for speed - use for quick refreshes, testing, or ingestion tasks

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.description: Best balance of quality and speed - recommended for daily generation

quality.name: Quality
quality.description: Maximum quality - use selectively for important stories or deep analysis

publish_gate.description: Stories below hold_threshold are withheld; below warn_threshold get a warning badge

synthesis_routing.description: Thresholds for classifying clusters as standard vs deep processing path

semantic_dedupe.description: Post-hoc semantic duplicate detection after item embedding (#257, ADR-0026). action: 'flag' marks items.duplicate_of_id/similarity for operator review; other values are reserved for future use.

light_rag.description: Inject up to max_anchors high-confidence historical story anchors into synthesis prompts for continuity (#259, ADR-0026).

retrieval_hook.description: Bounded, traced retrieval of related prior stories for every cluster (all synthesis strategies) between clustering and synthesis, for observability and the #281 context_anchors payload (#279, ADR-0026). Looser threshold than light_rag since results are supporting context, not necessarily prompt-injected.
